checks.text: With no accounts, the page shows the heading "TOTP Authenticator" and the text "No accounts yet".
Typing "JBSWY3DPEHPK3PXP" in the field labelled "Base32 Secret" and clicking "Add account" adds a list item containing "JBSWY3DPEHPK3PXP" and a 6-digit code; the text "No accounts yet" is gone.

Typing "otpauth://totp/Example:alice@example.com?secret=JBSWY3DPEHPK3PXP&issuer=Example" in the field labelled "otpauth URI" and clicking "Add account" adds a list item containing "Example:alice@example.com" and a 6-digit code.
Typing "INVALID_SECRET" in the field labelled "Base32 Secret" and clicking "Add account" shows the toast message "Invalid base32 secret" and adds no list item.
With an account added, clicking the button labelled "Copy code" copies the current 6-digit code to the clipboard and shows the toast message "Code copied".
Clicking the button labelled "Delete Example:alice@example.com" removes that list item; if it was the only account, the text "No accounts yet" reappears.

Typing "JBSWY3DPEHPK3PXP" in the field labelled "Base32 Secret" and clicking "Add account" twice adds two list items, each with a distinct label suffix like "(1)" and "(2)" or identical secrets shown separately.
The field labelled "Base32 Secret" accepts only uppercase alphanumeric characters; typing "abc" is auto-converted to "ABC" or rejected with a validation message.
Reload keeps the account added with secret "JBSWY3DPEHPK3PXP"; the list item containing "JBSWY3DPEHPK3PXP" and a 6-digit code is still visible.
